Hawking Radiation and Black Hole Thermodynamics

1. Quantum Field Theory in Curved Spacetime

In 1974, Stephen Hawking demonstrated that black holes are not completely black, but emit thermal blackbody radiation due to quantum vacuum fluctuations near the event horizon.

Hawking Temperature: TH = ℏ c3 / (8 π G M kB)
Bekenstein-Hawking Black Hole Entropy: SBH = (kB c3 A) / (4 G ℏ)

where A = 4 π rs2 is the surface area of the event horizon. The entropy is strictly proportional to horizon area rather than volume.
